book.title: Playing to Win
book.author: A. G. Lafley and Roger L. Martin

predict.question: Every job passes Make, Deliver and Support. In B, each handles five jobs/hour. How many completed jobs per hour can B sustain?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Playing to Win connects strategic choices with the capabilities needed to make those choices work together.
modelBoundary: Every job needs all three steps. A completes {A} jobs/hour; B completes {B}. B has less total capacity, yet each step handles five. Jobs are identical; real strategy involves more than this stipulated rate model.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
